parsed.rationale_overall: System A provides more precise, actionable recommendations with specific dollar amounts tied to the actual $320K portfolio and includes a distinct short-duration bond recommendation addressing the education timeline's sequence-of-returns risk. System B contains a factual error (basing allocations on $140K net worth rather than $320K portfolio) and has less precise risk_level assignments (e.g., labeling the 529 as moderate risk when age-based glide paths de-risk over time).
